title: Refund Holdback on Northloop Payments On-Demand Payouts
content:
**Rule.** Northloop keeps back a refund holdback from a Northloop Payments on-demand payout. The refund holdback is the seller-funded refund debits of the last month times a refund holdback share of 1.0 when those refund debits are positive and at least 10 percent of the sale credits of the last month, 0.5 when they are positive and at least 5 percent but below 10 percent, and 0 otherwise, rounded to the cent.

It is deducted from the on-demand payable amount together with any other holdback kept back from the payout; the on-demand payout so obtained is never below zero, is capped at the plan's maximum per payout and is rounded to the cent. What is kept back stays in the balance and is paid with later scheduled payouts.

A window of the last month takes in the ledger entries dated after the same calendar day one month before the request date, up to and including the request date.

## Share by refund level

| Seller-funded refund debits of the last month | Refund holdback share |
|---|---|
| positive and at least 10% (0.10) of the sale credits of the last month | 1.0 |
| positive and at least 5% (0.05) but below 10% of those sale credits | 0.5 |
| any other case, including no refund debits | 0 |

## Hypothetical boundary cases (sale credits of the last month 20000.00 USD)

- Refund debits 2000.00 USD: exactly 10 percent, share 1.0, holdback 2000.00 USD.
- Refund debits 1500.00 USD: below 10 but at least 5 percent, share 0.5, holdback 750.00 USD.
- Refund debits 1000.00 USD: exactly 5 percent, share 0.5, holdback 500.00 USD.
- Refund debits 999.99 USD: below 5 percent, share 0, no holdback.
